# authwise_asset_content (Resource)

The file behind an `authwise_asset`: the bytes the hosted pages serve at the asset's `path`.

`authwise_asset` manages only the asset's metadata. kit stores the file separately, through its upload and download calls, and this resource manages that part. Set exactly one of `source`, a local file, or `content_base64`. Changes are tracked by `content_sha256`: editing the file plans an in-place update that uploads it again, and a file changed outside Terraform shows as drift.

Destroying it removes the file and leaves the asset. Destroying the `authwise_asset` removes both.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authwise_asset" "logo" {
  display_name = "Logo"
  path         = "/logo.svg"
  mime_type    = "image/svg+xml"
}

# The file the hosted pages serve at the asset's path. Editing logo.svg
# plans an in-place update that uploads it again.
resource "authwise_asset_content" "logo" {
  asset_id = authwise_asset.logo.asset_id
  source   = "${path.module}/logo.svg"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_id` (String) The asset the content belongs to: `authwise_asset.x.asset_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `content_base64` (String) The content, base64-encoded, e.g. `filebase64("logo.png")` or `base64encode(templatefile(...))`. Conflicts with `source`.
- `source` (String) Path to a local file to upload. Conflicts with `content_base64`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of the content: the planned content before apply, and the content kit serves after a refresh.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the asset's full resource name. source or content_base64 comes
# from configuration; the first apply uploads it.
terraform import authwise_asset_content.logo tenants/t-01/assets/as-01
```
